hints.title: Run Length Encoding Lengths
hints.text: The compressed length of a run of count c is 1 for c = 1, 2 for c = 2..9, 3 for c = 10..99, and 4 for c = 100.

hints.title: Delete vs Keep Decisions
hints.text: At index i with k deletions remaining, decide to either delete s[i] or keep s[i] as the anchor of a compressed block.

hints.title: Block Extension
hints.text: If keeping s[i], scan forward to j, matching characters equal to s[i] and deleting differing characters using available k quota.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 2^N deletion subsets is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D dynamic programming over (index, remaining deletions) explores O(N * K) states with O(N) forward scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates optimal block chunking with deletions inside the DP transition.
